chunks: Saying: "Ah woe, who has roused us from our sleep?" This is what Ar-Rahman had promised, and whose truth the apostles had affirmed.
ai.seo_question: What do people say when they are resurrected from their graves according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the sudden transition from the 'sleep' of Barzakh to the reality of resurrection, emphasizing the fulfillment of divine promise (Wa'd) and the veracity of the Prophets. The exclamation 'O woe to us' reflects the regret of those who recognized the truth but failed to act, underscoring the concept of divine justice where the messengers' warnings are vindicated. This moment serves as a pivotal confirmation of the Hereafter, linking the intermediate state of the grave directly to the final accountability.
